body: In gates: fa7dc4a, the Joust spec. Sinistar voice v3 is approved and waits for the owner to listen. Copying VectorCraft's 4bab2ea, 095003e, 5fec214, f4a7363 and 3439c97 as each lands. Lesson: our voice agent wrote measure.rs while VectorCraft's measurer existed, and a later agent cherry-picked it from an unlanded branch. Proposal: before spawning a tooling agent, run xtask status and sync-check, and name any existing work in the prompt.
summary: Check-in: nothing landed since 5144a51; lesson that the sound measurer was built twice; proposal to check status and sync-check before spawning a tooling agent
